about:
.GA is a country-code top-level domain (ccTLD) in the DNS root zone. It is designated for Gabon. The IANA root zone lists the registry manager as Agence Nationale des Infrastructures Numériques et des Fréquences (ANINF). Registration policies (who may register, local presence, pricing) are set by the registry and its accredited registrars — not by IANA.

.ga is the country code top-level domain (ccTLD) for Gabon.
whoCanRegister: Eligibility is defined by the registry operator and its registrars. Most gTLDs are open to anyone worldwide. Many ccTLDs are also open globally; some require local presence, citizenship, or trademark rights. Always confirm current policy with the registry or your registrar.
